header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH, CIRCUIT COURT, MIRPURKHAS
(Mst. Kainat v/s. Province of Sindh & Ors)
Petitioner: Through Mr. Nabi Bux Saand, Advocate
body: 2. Through instant Petition, the Petitioner has claimed appointment against deceased quota available under Rule 11 - A of the Sindh Civil Servants (Appointment, Promotion & Transfer) Rule, 1974 (APT Rules).

3. It is the case of the Petitioner that his father Manthar was employed as Primary School Teacher in School Education Department Government of Sindh and died while in service on 12.08.2013. Petitioner at the time of death of her father was aged about 11 years and on attaining majority vide application dated 06.02.2020 She approached the Respondents to consider her case for appointment but to no avail. Learned Counsel therefore prays for appropriate directions.

4. Learned Assistant Advocate General, present in Court in other matters waives notice of the Petition and upon perusal of case file states Government of Sindh has constituted a committee to consider the cases of children of deceased employees in terms of Rule 11-A of APT Rules. He therefore, submits that the case of the Petitioner may be referred to the Departmental Scrutiny Committee. The proposal has been agreed to by Learned Counsel for the Petitioner and seeks disposal of the petition. Order accordingly.
5. Since Petitioner filed application within time on attaining the majority, therefore her case shall be dealt within time.

6. In view of above, this petition is disposed of. The Respondents are directed to place the case of Petitioner before the departmental scrutiny committee and decide the same within a period of 3 months’ time from date of this order.
7. Office is directed to send copy of this Order to the Respondents for compliance.
